prompt.text:
Implement a CommonJS module exporting exactly `{ assembleDeploymentRegistry }`.

`assembleDeploymentRegistry(locations, units)` returns a promise. A location is `{ code, label, category, latitude, longitude }`; a unit is `{ serial, locationCode, contact }`. Both arguments must be arrays. All string fields must be non-empty, coordinates must be finite numbers, location codes and unit serials must be unique, and every unit must reference an existing location. Type-shape failures throw `TypeError`; duplicates or missing references throw `RangeError`.

Without mutating or retaining aliases to either input, assign location IDs sequentially from 100 in input order. Return a promise resolving to `{ locations, units }`, where location records contain their original fields plus `id`, and unit records contain `{ serial, locationId, contact }`. Unit order must match its input order. Empty arrays resolve to empty arrays. Validation must finish before the resolved registry is exposed, and changing returned records must not affect the inputs.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
